notes.title: Upper Correction for Watame
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made to the abilities of the playable character "Watame".
Before change: [Start of Match]Draw -2
After change: [Start of Match]Draw [b]-1[/b]

As a result, the player starts with 4 cards in hand at the beginning of the match.
